errors.problem: The page never returns to j_{f-1}. Its procedure ends with 'one scan refilling holes in order applies $T_0$', where T_0 does the XORs only at j_0,...,j_{f-2}, so the stated goal $y_{j_i}\leftarrow y_{j_i}\oplus x_{j_i}$ for $0\le i<f$ is not met, and for f=1 the procedure does nothing. The paper finishes with a two-bit XOR on x_{j_{f-1}}, y_{j_{f-1}} by the elementary-streams lemma in O(V), and says that for f=1 this is the entire algorithm.

errors.quote: lines 1 to 4 permute the parities of $(u,w)$ by $(00\ 01\ 10)$ and lines 5 to 8 by $(01\ 10\ 11)$, composing to $(00\ 10)(01\ 11)$. So $(u',w')=(u+c(1-2(u\bmod2)),w)$: ... quotients by two persist
errors.problem: A permutation of parities alone does not imply that the quotients by two are preserved. The paper says each cycle acts on the corners of every square {2a,2a+1}x{2b,2b+1} (translation by (2a,2b) changes no predicate), and that is what gives the formula.

errors.quote: As $q'$ permutes $\mathcal B$, keys are distinct
errors.problem: q' is a single address. It is the map $T_0S_0^{-1}$ (q -> q') that permutes B, as the paper says.
